contract.admission: The runtime-authored source contains ten MLINESTYLE elements with offsets [1.25,-0.75,-1.25,-2.0,-2.5,-3.0,-3.5,-4.0,-4.5,-5.0], ACI [1,3,4,5,6,7,8,9,10,11] and alternating ByLayer/Continuous linetypes. Two source-bound ordinary MLINEs consume it. The target appends exactly one tuple (-5.5, ACI 12, ByLayer), producing eleven elements. Source and target flags are 2 with equal angles. Both consumers are open, uncut and unfilled.
contract.geometry: The source recipe recalculates all ten source group-41 pairs for each of three vertices against the source minimum -5.0. The append transaction recalculates all eleven output pairs against target minimum -5.5. Consumers have positive finite scale, center/bottom justification, unit extrusion, source-consistent positions/directions/miters, two segment parameters per element, zero second values, absent group 42 and zero area-fill counts.
contract.identityAndOutput: The MLINESTYLE retains its source name and emits group 71 = 11, all eleven group-49 offsets, the style flag color plus eleven element ACI values, and eleven element linetype names. Unique ByLayer and Continuous LTYPE providers are checked. Both MLINE consumers retain source names and group 340 to the emitted style handle; each emits group 73 = 11 and exact group-74/group-41/group-75 arrays. Fresh import verifies the eleven style tuples and both consumer parameter arrays, geometry vectors, scale and extrusion in model space and a named block.
contract.failureAndRetry: An unsupported style flag refuses before publication and preserves the destination and caller snapshot; restoring flag 2 allows same-adapter retry. A late mutation to a live consumer parameter refuses before publication; restoring captured caller state allows same-adapter retry. Both failure classes are exercised with ASCII and binary output.
contract.compatibility: No public API or DRW_Interface virtual changes. AC1027 sources and outputs are authored at runtime and removed after success; no DWG/DXF fixtures are committed.
